read.en: Zscaler fell 1.7% on Oct 28 to $255.80, trading between $254.29 and $265.99. It is above the rising 5-day ($253.9), 10-day ($235.6), 30-day ($217.9), 100-day ($174.6) and 200-day ($166.6) averages. MACD has been above its signal since Oct 22 and above zero, histogram flattening; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Oct 22 ($214.14), and RSI is 70, just off overbought.
read.zh: Zscaler 10月28日下跌 1.7%，收于 $255.80，盘中区间 $254.29–265.99。股价位于上行的 5 日（$253.9）、10 日（$235.6）、30 日（$217.9）、100 日（$174.6）和 200 日均线（$166.6）上方。MACD 自 10月22日起位于信号线上方且在零轴之上，柱状图走平；抛物线 SAR 自 10月22日起看多（$214.14），RSI 为 70，刚从超买区回落。

read.en: A second push toward $268 faded at $266, and the close held the $255.5 support (Oct 27 low, Oct 23 high) after a dip to $254.3. No level changed. Resistance is $261.5 (Oct 26 high), then $266–270.1 (Oct 27–28 highs, Nov 26, 2025 high) and $289.7. Support is $253.9–255.6 (5-day, Oct 23 high), then $250 and $241.2 (Oct 22 high). A close above $268 would target $270–290; below $253.9, $250.
